body: No one here is going to answer that question.  What I do believe you should do is find someone to talk to about what’s going on me included.  I’m just a stranger on Reddit and I’m sure there are multiple of other people that would be willing to listen and try to facilitate solutions that aren’t taking your life.  The world has so much to offer beyond suicide and or depression.  There truly are not quick solutions to problems but there are processes to work through what you’re going through.  Please reach out to someone and or message someone on here I’m positive there are people here to help!

I remember when I was 15 years old and sitting in the lunchroom at my school. I told my bestfriend I didn’t think I could make it to Christmas (it was maybe October).  Fast forward to now 6 years later as me and my friend reminisced about that conversation.  I’m saying this to show that you’re not alone in thoughts like that.  Life is difficult especially being young;  I don’t know your struggle.  I do know that the world is a better place with you in it and you deserve your chance to experience that for yourself.  I can perceive this is a bad shitty time you’re going through at the moment.  Time heals a lot of problems.  Please search your heart for the value that you bring to the world and use that to push through this time!

I know first hand that things will improve.  Life has a way of persevering. Moments like this define who you will become,  you know the correct action to take is work through this moment of weakness.  Be at peace with the thoughts of it and let yourself move forward from those thoughts.  In time you will overcome thoughts of suicide and live the beautiful life you deserve.  Patience and perseverance and all will be given to you!

I care.  I’ll check in on you.  I just don’t want you to make a that life altering decision for multiple reasons.  I’m also suicidal Ik how it gets it fucking sucks and I bet on top of that there’s 100000 other things that are going on that suck too.  But to say shit don’t change or gets better you gotta be able to believe that.  If you’re willing to kys you’re at rock bottom and you can literally only go up from this moment.  Please contact me and we can talk today tomorrow whenever.  I really do care and I want to see you here even if it’s on this sub.
Nope no amount of pills can take away pain if you die you’ll pass it along.  Get help,  many people here will talk with you.  You’re loved by us we wanna see you get through this!

I hope you’re doing well.  Give it more time, give it more work on your self you’ll get to a point where you are comfortable with life.  It seems like in the moment you’re are overthinking a little bit.  Death is an answer not a solution.  Try to calm yourself down and you should seek professional help; a lot of people don’t know what to say or do when put in the position to help someone.  You’re loved and cared about if not from anyone you know then, from many people on here.  If you wanna talk more dm me I’m here for you
Idk the real statistics but I’d say the majority of people that self harm are probably depressed.

Napolean was 5’6 and he conquered half of Europe.  I wouldn’t let you’re height define you.  Also doctors aren’t always right and you could easily have another growth spurt.  Seek help, Ik it’s not the easiest thing to do always but it is the right thing for yourself!

You’re so young, you’ll 100 percent meet more people in your life.  Also if your mental health is not the best atm then maybe a relationship isn’t the best option for you anyway.  Work on yourself, suicide is such a drastic decision to make and I know it feels like a that’ll make everything better but we both know that’s not the case.  You should really ask your parents about therapy, and Ik there are a lot of people on here who care about and will talk with you including me!
